walkthroughs.body_html:
Area E: The International World — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area E: The International World brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area E: The International World.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: In which year did Algeria gain independence from France?
Which is NOT part of the Maghreb?
options: Algérie
Maroc
Tunisie
Sénégal
À France.
Dans France.
Future tense.
En France.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to my friend's house' in French?
options: Je vais à mon ami.
Je vais chez mon ami.
Future tense.
Je vais à la maison de mon ami.

mcqs.q: What tense follows 'depuis' for ongoing situations in French?
options: Future tense.
Dans France.
Past tense (because it is translated as 'have lived' in English).
Present tense (J'habite ici DEPUIS 5 ans - I have lived here for 5 years).
